review_binding.implementation: ofqual_admission.implementation_binding hashes default ast.dump(FunctionDef, include_attributes=False) for normalize, tokens and negative_matches.
review_binding.mechanism: Python 3.13 introduced show_empty=False and omission of optional empty list fields by default. The stored review hashes include the Python 3.12 representation; default AST dump output is not a portable canonical serialization.

mock_delegation.mechanism: The isolation-test mock accepted only (path, pattern), while newer pathlib rglob forwards keyword options to glob. It also needs to preserve the actual recursive **/*.php walk rather than substitute synthetic Python paths.
mock_delegation.correction: Forward keyword arguments to the actual glob/rglob functions and retain actual PHP traversal; regression compares all delegated commands and 28 PHP invocations.

applied_candidate.preflight: Before expensive checks, reject a non-3.12 interpreter, read the original review using its existing immutable REVIEW_PIN, recompute the existing implementation binding and require exact equality. Print the resolved full Python version and existing function hashes.
applied_candidate.security_and_reproducibility: Select the latest available 3.12 patch, retaining a fail-closed original-binding check. Only local 3.12.14 has been verified here; a newly resolved patch is not accepted until its actual current-head CI passes.
applied_candidate.unsupported_runtime: Python 3.13+ is not silently accepted or skipped; the explicit runtime/binding preflight must fail.
